changes.title: Exact grouped-record drilldown
changes.text: Opening a statistics group now shows exactly its records, keeping lower bounds and differently capitalized text separate.

changes.title: Group selection and saved queries
changes.text: Added regression coverage for group membership, persisted drilldowns and real touch interaction in native group sheets.

changes.title: Verified build evidence
changes.text: Recorded TEST104's actual verified delivery and this build's changes, tests and compatibility limits.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I fixed grouped statistics that could open the wrong records. Ordinary filters still work the same way, while drilldowns retain the exact group you selected.
